title: Control Room: Scripted
description: Run the same kind of ambiguous training problem as a living multi-agent script. Four personas take controlled turns through a shared fact ledger, source grounding, adversarial challenge, decision gate, and final brief. The script creates and removes its own cast. Re-open it from the 🪄 icon.

entries.label: Start the structured discussion
entries.description: Launch the four-person script and watch its living document in the right rail.
